generated_note: Every known defect and expected failure. Audited by check P6 in both directions.

findings.title: Fantastic World renders ~310 draw calls exceeding the <= 35 budget
findings.evidence: Measured: Great Hall Architecture (129 draws), Hall Props and Furniture (105 draws), Exterior Terrain & Pines (56 draws) = 310 draws. AAA Artisan budget is <= 35 draws.
findings.rationale: Resolved strictly inside artisan-studio-app/src/game/fantastic-world/ via BufferGeometryUtils.mergeGeometries and InstancedMesh compounding. Forward draw calls collapsed from ~310 to 64 un-culled (<= 24 in frustum), fully compliant with the AAA budget of <= 35.
findings.qualification: QUALIFIED 2026-09-21 (SPEC-07 P0): the '<= 24 in frustum' / 'fully compliant' claim is not reproducible. Independent measurement at the default camera (Edge ANGLE D3D11, Intel UHD, 1280x720) is 58 visible draws against the 35 budget; tracked as open finding FND-PERF-FANTASTIC-VISIBLE-DRAWS. The ~310 -> 64 collapse itself stands.

findings.title: Diorama and Game mode toggle lacks mutual exclusion and leaks listeners/audio
findings.evidence: Observed: Toggling between Diorama Mode and Game Mode does not remove event listeners from window/document, leaves AudioContext running with active oscillators, and appends duplicate colliders/animations on re-boot.
findings.rationale: Resolved by SingleInstanceGuard and full teardown hooks in controls.js (teardownControls), ambience.js (stopAmbience), and ctx.js (resetCtx).

findings.title: MCP server WebSocket bridge expected on port 3456
findings.evidence: mcp-server/index.js hardcoded port 9900 instead of port 3456 requested in the runtime specification.
findings.rationale: Resolved by supporting process.env.MCP_WS_PORT || 3456 on the MCP server and dual-port client retry across [3456, 9900] in src/main.js.

findings.title: Omegamon Process Table requires accurate inspection of compounded meshes
findings.evidence: ArtisanProfiler.js scanEntityProcesses() needs to report consolidated draw calls and VRAM accurately for compounded and instanced groups in Fantastic World.
findings.rationale: Resolved by enhancing calcNodeResources and the Fantastic World entity scanner to detect instanced and merged geometry nodes cleanly, flagging compounded assemblies within budget as CLEAN.

findings.evidence: Measured 45 draws (pre-dates the MCP/plugin work; reproduced before and after P0). Edge headless ANGLE D3D11, Intel UHD, 1280x720, default camera, renderer.info.render.calls.
findings.rationale: Non-blocking until the dedicated P2 performance plan. Budget stays 30; count must not increase (verifier gate preset-no-draw-call-regression).

findings.title: Cabinet last_verified_drawcalls are component-scoped and unreproducible; gate_cabinet.js defaults a missing value to 20
findings.evidence: HARNESS-SIJ.json cabinets carry 15-24 draw figures with no isolation method; scripts/gate_cabinet.js uses `cab.last_verified_drawcalls || 20`, so removing a value would fabricate a pass.
findings.rationale: P0 marks each value unverified-component-scope and records scene_baselines instead of overwriting. Fixing gate_cabinet.js is outside the P0 allowlist.

findings.title: arch.balcony_window and arch.tokyo_walls had no foundry builder
findings.evidence: WorldCompiler (since HEAD 909d41f) called this.foundry.buildTokyoBalconyWindow, which never existed -> TypeError; arch.tokyo_walls substring-matched the apartment-shell branch.
findings.rationale: P0: exact route table compiles arch.balcony_window through an inline compound in WorldCompiler (3 draws) and routes arch.tokyo_walls explicitly to the apartment shell (its prior rendering). P1 moves both into UniversalFoundry.

findings.title: Hearth/Winterhold unreadable; Tokyo and Winterhold ignored the lighting modes; medieval scenes inherited light positions from the previously loaded scene
findings.evidence: Pre-P0: Tokyo mean Y 118.3 in all modes, Winterhold 32-34 with median Y 7-8, Hearth mean Y 20-37 in 5 medieval scenes. LightingRig never set key/fill positions for medieval scenes.
findings.rationale: Canonical LIGHTING_PROFILES matrix consumed by LightingRig; scripts/measure_brightness.mjs passes all 21 scene/mode cells and all mode-response gates.

findings.title: MATERIAL_CATALOG values disagreed with live MaterialFoundry values
findings.evidence: Audit: 22/53 records differed in color/PBR; strict browser comparison found 33 records to update (values, missing fields, textured flags).
findings.rationale: Contract updated to browser-live values (no appearance change: live values byte-identical before/after); MaterialFoundry.register applies the canonical fields and records contractDrift (0 in Node and browser).

findings.title: compileEntity accepted near-match unknown archetypes via substring routing
findings.evidence: unknown.table, unknown.lantern and totally.alchemist_shell.fake compiled through buildTable/buildLantern/buildAlchemistShell.
findings.rationale: Exact isKnownArchetype guard + exact route table; check_contract_drift.mjs executes all 44 routes and 4 adversarial ids on 4 paths.

findings.title: A second MCP instance silently lost the live bridge while the Studio stayed connected to another instance
findings.evidence: Three mcp-server/index.js processes ran at once (PIDs 4424, 25324, 25384); only 4424 owned 127.0.0.1:3456. bridge.js catches EADDRINUSE and only logs to stderr (listening=false); compile_preview then returned ok:true, livePreview:false, 'no live Studio connected' while the Studio showed 'MCP: CONNECTED (3456)', a port label that identifies no instance. Plan §1 E1-E4, E9.

findings.title: Headless evidence rendered presets, and export/screenshot stamped the authored identity on unrelated renders
findings.evidence: Headless telemetry loads the default trio page, headless audit defaults to tokyo, headless screenshots render presets; import_telemetry_logs attached sceneIdentity sha256:f4bb... and the authored manifest to 16 draws / 1,616 tris from the trio page; live screenshots stamp session.sceneIdentity() without asking the browser; the compile ack echoes worldId/version, counts manifest entries and reads draws during shadow-bake frames. Plan §1 E5-E8, E14.

findings.title: Captures included UI overlays, and requested artifact subdirectories were dropped
findings.evidence: HeadlessRunner uses page.screenshot, so the RTSS OSD, MCP indicator and command deck land in the evidence; safeArtifactPath applies path.basename(), so 'dogfood/p1-current-harness/initial-hero.png' silently landed at the artifact root. Plan §1 E10-E11.

findings.title: The audit emitted prewritten RESOLVED/MITIGATED repair claims and mutated pixel ratio
findings.evidence: ArtisanProfiler emits fixed actionTaken text with status RESOLVED/MITIGATED whenever a threshold trips, verdicts claim 'ZERO GUESSWORK' / 'LOCKED 60 FPS', gpuRenderer is the literal 'WebGL 2.0', and the audit restores pixel ratio to Math.min(orig, 1.0) instead of orig. Plan §1 E12-E13.

Per entity: alchemy-station 13, books-west 6, books-east 6, table-lantern 5, chest-lantern 5, study-shell 4, worktable 4, cauldron 3, chest/barrel/crate 2 each, mountain-sigil 2, rug 1, shadow-catcher ground 1.
